description: This file defines the class 'CategoryWithNotesCount', which models a category along with the count of notes within it, associated with a specific account. It is used in the context of Android's Room persistence library for database operations.

classes.name: CategoryWithNotesCount
classes.description: A POJO class representing a category with an associated notes count within a specific account, used for database queries and entity mapping.
